title.narrative: Support t the Return of State Services in Somalia

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to Somalia’s transition out of fragility by strengthening stability and security and by creating a favorable environment for economic and social development. The European Union (EU) has engaged UNOPS as an implementing partner to construct the Dhuusamareeb military compound in support of actions that aim at improving the Somalia Security Forces (SSF) capacity and to increase the impact and to create synergies between the different actions, building on the capacity of the Somali National Army by providing a conducive environment for training, hence creating better conditions, more efficient deployment of troops around the country, and providing security to the Somali population. Security in turn helps in strengthening Somalia’s governance and democratic standards. \nThe Action forms part of the EU support to the implementation of the Somali Transition Plan that foresees a progressive transfer of security responsibilities from the AMISOM to the Somali security institutions. The project will address a very high priority agreed in 2017 at the London Somalia Conference, in the scope of the reform of the SSF and will complement the efforts of other donors working in the same sector.\n
